dropped.claim: OPKO represents a speculative pharmaceutical transition with no path to profitability visible in the financials. While the company strategically exited diagnostics for $223.1M in total gains, the core business deteriorated severely with net losses worsening from $53.2M to $225.7M in 2025 despite those gains, operating cash flow of -$178.5M, and free cash flow margin of -31.4%. Despite operating losses improving from $226.3M to $117.4M, the business burns cash at nearly one-third of revenue with continuing diagnostics operations showing organic volume declines of $10.2M. The pharmaceutical portfolio has NGENLA approved in 50+ markets, but revenue contribution is unclear and pipeline catalysts (Phase 1 data, IND filings) remain distant at late 2026. With net cash of only $20.4M against annual cash burn of $178.5M, equity dilution of 8.2% year-over-year, and no credible near-term path to profitability, this is uninvestable despite the strategic repositioning.

Strategic divestitures generated $223.1M in total gains ($101.6M in 2025, $121.5M in 2024) while refocusing the company on pharmaceuticals, and the business now holds net cash of $20.4M ($364.4M cash versus $344.0M long-term debt) providing runway despite operating losses.
